On 2026-11-16 the official report url returns the league's most recent report for every week that has no report of its own - 2025 W1-W18 and 2026 W1-W11 all answered with a Week 10 page. Past weekly reports are NOT archived at this url, so a multi-week designation history must come from dated snapshots, not from a back-fill of past urls.
